user.title: Connect to Moonraker
user.description: Enter the IP address of your Anycubic Kobra printer running Rinkhals with the mmu_ace plugin.

models.title: Select ACE Hardware Models
models.description: {num_units} ACE unit(s) detected. Select the hardware model for each — this sets the correct maximum drying temperature.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Moonraker. Check the IP address and make sure the printer is powered on.
error.invalid_response: Unexpected response from Moonraker. Make sure Rinkhals is installed with the mmu_ace plugin enabled.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant logs for details.

init.title: Material Presets
init.description: Enter up to 8 material presets. Format: **Name:Temperature** (e.g. `PLA:45`). Leave a slot blank to disable it.
